content: {"episode_id":"ep-05054","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication documents a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and recent transient cerebral ischemic attacks, with intermittent palpitations and brief episodes of neurological deficits. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to optimize rate and rhythm control strategies."}
